summary: Trace data from storage through decoding and host memory to the GPU so input starvation is measurable and repairable.
outcomes: Locate storage, preprocessing, transfer and compute bottlenecks.
Choose buffering and direct-storage features based on actual support and measurement.
sequence: Draw a file-to-result pipeline with rates and queue capacities.
Measure read, decode, transform and copy stages separately.
Add bounded prefetch and pinned staging.
Compare compressed input, batching and GPUDirect Storage where supported.
Validate correctness and monitor memory growth under backpressure.

visual.question: Which stage starves or overwhelms the next stage?
visual.interaction: Change stage speed and buffer count; show idle and backpressure.

practice.task: Optimize a reproducible input pipeline with a fixed dataset.
practice.success: Throughput gains are measured end to end; buffer use stays bounded and data ordering is preserved where required.
